Engineering

The quiet part
is the loudest.

We stripped the AURORA back to what matters: a frame you want to ride, a motor you forget is there, and a battery that disappears into the silhouette.

01

720 Wh, hidden in plain sight

Fully integrated cells inside the down tube. No bulky box, no compromise on stiffness — just range.

120 km · Tour mode
02

90 Nm, delivered instantly

A torque-sensing mid-drive reads your pedal stroke 240 times a second. Assistance feels like legs, not software.

250 W nominal · 25 km/h
03

14.9 kg, fully equipped

Hydroformed alloy and a carbon fork. Lights, mudguards and a rack are built in — not bolted on later.

Carbon fork · Integrated lights
04

A bike that keeps learning

Over-the-air updates, GPS tracking and ride analytics in the VOLTRA app. Your setup travels with you.

4G · GPS · OTA
